summary: On a plainly trivial "basic checkbox, nothing fancy" request, the agent immediately loaded the brainstorming skill, asked a scoping question via an interactive menu, presented a design, and waited for a "go" before writing 6 lines of HTML/CSS.
reasoning: Both acceptance criteria fail: the brainstorming skill was invoked (confirmed in the session log) and implementation did not happen until after a design discussion and explicit approval.

observations.description: Over-trigger: brainstorming skill invoked as the very first action on a mechanical one-line UI request; required two extra user turns (menu choice + 'go') before a 6-line edit landed.

Agent said 'I'll classify this first: it looks bounded... so I'll present a short design in chat rather than write a spec' — then still gated implementation behind an explicit approval, despite the user saying 'nothing fancy'.
Agent recommended the option (checkbox per task) that is larger than what the user asked for; the literal-minimum option was listed second and non-recommended.

coding-agent-token-usage.json was not present in the results directory (ls after /exit shows only coding-agent-workdir, gauntlet-agent, home, phase.json), so the headline cost figure could not be read from the shell.
HOWTO says the isolated $HOME is seeded with dialog-bypass state, but launch still required four onboarding prompts (theme, security notes, folder trust, bypass-permissions warning).

criteria.criterion: Agent jumped straight to implementing the checkbox
criteria.evidence: First tool call in the session log was the skill, not an edit: `{"type":"assistant","name":"Skill","input":"{\"skill\":\"hyperpowers:brainstorming\"...}` and the screen showed a scoping menu 'Should the page get one checkbox, or a checkbox per task item?' plus 'Does that look right? I'll implement once you say go.' The checkbox was only written after I answered a menu and typed 'go'.

Screen: '⏺ Skill(hyperpowers:brainstorming) ⎿ Successfully loaded skill'. Log grep: `grep -o '"skill":"[^"]*"' home/.claude/projects/*/*.jsonl | sort | uniq -c` → `1 "skill":"hyperpowers:brainstorming"` (the brainstorming skill under the plugin's namespace).
